provenance.decision: PNG exports are NOT tracked in git. This manifest is; the PNGs are not. Recorded by AFC-223.
provenance.reason: 8.8 MB of derived binaries for 26 screens. Regenerable from the single source of truth, and versioned already as an attachment. Repo weight for a reviewer who opens them once is not a good trade.
provenance.source_of_truth: docs/wireframes/church-portal-events-hifi.html (tracked). Screens, tokens and layout all live there.
provenance.canonical_copy: Attachment 11b39e13-8b38-4a62-ac19-bb0768256ed2 on AFC-198, 'Church Portal - Events PNG exports', church-portal-events-hifi-png.zip. Verified HTTP 200 / 8,629,896 bytes; all 27 entries inflate to bytes identical to the working-tree copies. Attachment storage does not depend on the workspace, so this survives a tree wipe.
provenance.regenerate: No render script is committed and none is planned. The renders were produced by a one-off headless-browser pass with no playwright/chromium dependency in this repo, so there is nothing here to re-run. If the PNGs are ever needed again, re-render from the tracked HTML; do not restore them from the tree.
provenance.filename_convention: Bare E<n>.png is the primary export for that screen. @1440 / @390 suffix marks a second capture at that width. @390-2/-3/-4 are repeat captures of the same screen at 390 during iteration and are retained only as history.
provenance.known_defect_in_attached_html: Attachment 812e0d8b-dd5b-42e4-8abb-90b8fc9d67b2 on AFC-198 is CORRUPTED: a Cloudflare email-protection pass rewrote 8 PNG filename references (E1@1440, E2@1440, E3@1440, E4@390, E4@390-2, E8@390, E9@1440, E10@1440) into anti-spam email links. The tracked HTML is clean. The document events-hifi-source is separately lossy: 4 U+FFFD where middle dots belong. Git is therefore the only clean copy of the hi-fi file.
